notes.title: Improvements to Level Editor
notes.content:
Wand case is different from build mode and playing mode. Editor can give custom wands to player.
Spells list is different from build mode and playing mode.
Enemies in level editor can be given a score for being defeated.
Custom levels can track max score and lowest time after beating a level.
Editor can place custom notes in level for player to see when playing a custom level.

notes.title: Added Flags
notes.content:
Added a flag system for custom levels. Flag system allows to add winning conditions for custom levels. As well as, guiding players.

Level editor supports placing items from using the wand spell choose system.

Some bug fixes with spell selection.

notes.title: Updates to Custom Level Editor
notes.content:
Updates to the level editor:


Enemies can be added to custom levels.
Added a button, in the build menu, for switching between editing and testing level.
Upgrades menu can be edited to change player stats when playing custom level.
Create custom artifacts in level editor.
Place artifacts in custom level.
Artifacts placed on grid will be available for player while playing custom level.



Further work for sharing levels online was also done but is not yet available.
